comparison: every ranked row carries a cost reference
description: Cost-ranked rows without a unit cost cannot be priced.
remediation: Add unit_cost to the ingredient master.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select round(1 - count(*) filter (where cost_coverage = 0)::double / nullif(count(*),0), 4) from main.mart_waste_priority", "operator": "gte", "value": 1.0}

comparison: every metric the registry promises to the dashboard is displayable
description: The registry promises certain metrics to the dashboard. If their trust state no longer allows it, the values are withheld and the promise is out of date.
remediation: Widen the allowed trust states of the metric, or stop promising it in the dashboard.
check_spec: {"kind": "dashboard_consistency"}

comparison: all dbt models built and all dbt tests passed
description: A failed model or test means the warehouse does not match the contract.
remediation: Re-run dbt build and fix the failing node.
check_spec: {"kind": "dbt_tests"}

comparison: demand denominator present for at least half the ranked rows
description: A waste rate without a demand denominator is not publishable as a rate.
remediation: Backfill sales for the affected days or publish the row as unverified.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select round(avg(case when demand_coverage >= 0.5 then 1 else 0 end), 4) from main.mart_waste_priority", "operator": "gte", "value": 0.5}

comparison: no duplicate sale_id
description: Every sale line must appear exactly once.
remediation: Re-run silver dedup on sale_id.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from (select sale_id from main.fct_sales group by 1 having count(*) > 1)", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}

comparison: no duplicate waste_id
description: Every waste event must appear exactly once.
remediation: Re-run silver dedup on waste_id.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from (select waste_id from main.fct_waste_events group by 1 having count(*) > 1)", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}

comparison: sales data at most 2 days behind the newest event
description: Demand denominators must be current or rates are misleading.
remediation: Re-run ingestion for the missing days.
check_spec: {"kind": "data_recency", "source": "sales", "compare_to": "events"}

comparison: every published mart resolves to at least one source
description: A mart without a resolved source cannot be traced back to a delivery.
remediation: Check the model dependencies in the dbt manifest.
check_spec: {"kind": "dbt_manifest"}

comparison: every published metric is protected by an expectation or a dbt test
description: A published metric whose source model nothing tests or checks is a number with no protection. It cannot be shown as measured.
remediation: Add a dbt test or a declared expectation for the metric source model.
check_spec: {"kind": "metric_coverage"}

comparison: every published metric has a definition, an owner and allowed trust states
description: A metric without a definition cannot be trusted or explained.
remediation: Complete the row in mart_metric_registry.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from main.mart_metric_registry where published and (owner is null or definition is null or trust_states_allowed is null)", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}

comparison: no negative waste quantity
description: Negative waste would be a sign inversion.
remediation: Fix the source record; the contract quarantines these rows.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from main.fct_waste_events where waste_quantity < 0", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}

comparison: rejected rows below 2% of the source
description: A jump in rejected rows signals a broken upstream delivery.
remediation: Inspect data/quarantine for the affected source.
check_spec: {"kind": "quality_rate", "source": "*"}

comparison: mart waste cost equals cost recomputed from source rows
description: Cost must be reproducible from the delivered rows and the ingredient master.
remediation: Inspect the cost calculation and the ingredient master.
check_spec: {"kind": "reconciliation", "target": "waste_cost"}

comparison: mart waste quantity equals source waste quantity
description: Aggregation must not create or lose waste quantity.
remediation: Inspect the aggregation grain in the mart.
check_spec: {"kind": "reconciliation", "target": "waste_quantity"}

comparison: no silver source older than 3 days
description: A stale silver layer invalidates every downstream metric.
remediation: Re-run the ingestion for the stale source.
check_spec: {"kind": "source_freshness", "source": "*"}

comparison: summary waste cost equals the cost of the ranked backlog
description: The summary and the ranked backlog must price the same waste.
remediation: Inspect the cost aggregation in mart_food_loss_summary.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select abs((select waste_cost from main.mart_food_loss_summary where is_total = 1) - (select coalesce(sum(estimated_cost), 0) from main.mart_waste_priority))", "operator": "lte", "value": 0.01}

comparison: the published waste rate is a ratio of totals
description: The published waste rate must be total waste over total demand. An average of daily ratios is a different number and must never be published under this name.
remediation: Recompute the rate in mart_food_loss_summary as a ratio of sums.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select abs((select waste_rate_per_demand from main.mart_food_loss_summary where is_total = 1) - (select waste_quantity / nullif(ingredient_demand_qty, 0) from main.mart_food_loss_summary where is_total = 1))", "operator": "lte", "value": 0.000001}

comparison: the estate total equals the sum of the locations
description: The "all" row of the summary must be the sum of the per-location rows.
remediation: Inspect the estate aggregation in mart_food_loss_summary.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select abs((select waste_quantity from main.mart_food_loss_summary where is_total = 1) - (select coalesce(sum(waste_quantity), 0) from main.mart_food_loss_summary where is_total = 0))", "operator": "lte", "value": 0.001}

comparison: no duplicate grain keys
description: Waste opportunity grain (waste_date, location_id, ingredient_id, waste_reason) must be unique.
remediation: Aggregate to a coarser grain before publishing.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from (select waste_date, location_id, ingredient_id, waste_reason from main.mart_waste_opportunity group by 1,2,3,4 having count(*) > 1)", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}

comparison: all waste events resolve to location and ingredient
description: Waste events must resolve to a known location, ingredient and cost.
remediation: Add the missing reference row to the master data source.
check_spec: {"kind": "sql", "sql": "select count(*) from main.fct_waste_events where has_location_reference = 0 or has_ingredient_reference = 0", "operator": "eq", "value": 0}
